statements.dead:
SELECT q.id::text, q.attempts::bigint, COALESCE(q.last_error, ''),
  to_char(q.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
  (to_jsonb(q) - ARRAY['id', 'state', 'attempts', 'due_at', 'claim_expires_at', 'claim_token', 'last_error', 'created_at', 'updated_at']::text[])::text,
  count(*) OVER ()
FROM order_placed_queue AS q
WHERE q.state = 'dead'
ORDER BY q.updated_at, q.id
LIMIT $1
statements.states: SELECT q.id::text, q.state FROM order_placed_queue AS q WHERE q.id = ANY($1::text[]::uuid[])
statements.retry:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = now(), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id = ANY($1::text[]::uuid[])
RETURNING id::text
statements.retryAll:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = now(), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE state = 'dead'
RETURNING id::text
statements.drop:
DELETE FROM order_placed_queue
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id = ANY($1::text[]::uuid[])
RETURNING id::text
statements.dropAll:
